*Initial API Analysis*

To determine whether my project idea using MAC.BID is possible, 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

```

**Request and parse a recent batch of auctions**

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

batch_num <- 3

url <- "https://api.macdiscount.com/past-auctions?pg=1&ppg=50"

# Make the request and fetch the request's results,
# saving them in the response object
response <- request(url) |>
  req_perform()

auctions <- response |>
  # Using simplifyVector param to flatten the response's nested JSON
  resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

output_path <- file.path(
  "data",
  "discovery",
  "past_auctions",
  paste0("batch", batch_num, ".csv")
)

# Check that the file does not already exist
if (file.exists(output_path)) {
  stop(
    "File already exists and was not overwritten: ",
    output_path
  )
} else {
    # Save the parsed auction data
    write.csv(
    auctions,
    output_path,
    row.names = FALSE
    )

    message("Saved: ", output_path)
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
batch_num <- 1
auctions <- read.csv("data/discovery/past_auctions/batch1.csv")

auctions_by_id <- auctions |>
  mutate(
    # Ensure auction id is numeric
    id = as.integer(id),
    # Convert date_created from text into a datetime value
    date_created = as.POSIXct(
      date_created,
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ",
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  ) |>
  # Arrange auction id's numerically in ascending order
  arrange(id) |>
  mutate(
    # Create a column containing the previous auction's creation date
    # The first auction has no previous auction, so its value is NA
    previous_date = lag(date_created),
    date_went_backward = date_created < previous_date
  )

backward_summary <- auctions_by_id |>
  count(
    date_went_backward,
    name = "auction_count"
  )

# Determine whether creation time ever moves backward as ID increases
violations <- auctions_by_id |>
  filter(date_went_backward %in% TRUE)

backward_summary
violations

```

```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}

# Determine the observed ID boundaries
smallest_id <- min(auctions_by_id$id)
largest_id <- max(auctions_by_id$id)

# Generate every numeric ID within the observed boundaries
possible_ids <- seq.int(
  from = smallest_id,
  to = largest_id
)

# Find IDs inside the range that were absent from the response
unobserved_ids <- setdiff(
  possible_ids,
  auctions_by_id$id
)

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Empty list for auction records recovered from the unobserved id's
recovered_auctions <- list()

for (id in unobserved_ids) {

  # Build the API URL for this auction ID
  url <- paste0(
    "https://api.macdiscount.com/auctions/",
    id
  )

  # Make the request without stopping the loop for HTTP errors
  response <- request(url) |>
    req_error(is_error = function(resp) FALSE) |>
    req_perform()

  # Only keep successful responses
  if (resp_status(response) == 200) {

    auction <- response |>
      resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

    # Store each auction object recovered with the id as its identifier
    recovered_auctions[[as.character(id)]] <- auction
  }

  message("Recovered auction: ", id)

  # Brief pause before the next request
  Sys.sleep(0.7)
}

recovered_ids <- as.integer(names(recovered_auctions))

length(unobserved_ids)
length(recovered_ids)

all(unobserved_ids %in% recovered_ids)
setequal(unobserved_ids, recovered_ids)

```

```{r}
output_path <- file.path(
  "data",
  "discovery",
  "recovered_auctions",
  paste0("batch", batch_num, ".json")
)

# Prevent accidental overwriting
if (file.exists(output_path)) {
  stop(
    "File already exists: ",
    output_path
  )
} else {
    # Save as json for easy loading
    write_json(
        recovered_auctions,
        path = output_path,
        pretty = TRUE,
        auto_unbox = TRUE,
        na = "null",
        null = "null",
        digits = NA
    )

    message("Saved: ", output_path)
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Identify original column names retrieved via API from derived column names
original_cols <- names(auctions)

# New dataframe provides a copy of the auction data w/only its original columns
original_df <- auctions_by_id |>
  select(all_of(original_cols)) |>
  mutate(
    # Add a new column indicating that each row was not recovered later on
    is_recovered = FALSE
  )

recovered_rows <- lapply(
  recovered_auctions,
  function(recovered_auction) {
    
    # Only keep the columns that occur in the original API data
    recovered_auction <- recovered_auction[original_cols]
    
    # Replace NULL with NA
    recovered_auction <- lapply(
      recovered_auction,
      function(value) {
        if (is.null(value)) NA else value
      }
    )
    
    # Convert into a dataframe row
    as.data.frame(recovered_auction)
  }
)

# Combine all df rows into a single recovered dataframe
recovered_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  recovered_rows
)

recovered_df <- recovered_df |>
  mutate(
    id = as.integer(id),
    date_created = as.POSIXct(
      date_created,
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ",
      tz = "UTC"
    ), 
    is_recovered = TRUE
  )

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

complete_df <- bind_rows(
  original_df,
  recovered_df
) |>
  mutate(
    id = as.integer(id),
    date_launched = as.POSIXct(
      date_launched,
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ",
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(id)
 
```

auction_patterns <- complete_df |>

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

all_batches <- 1:3

comparison_cols <- c(
  "building_id",
  "location_id",
  "location_name",
  "prefix",
  "suffix",
  "n"
)

# setNames() assigns names to elements of a vector or list
# NOT to be confused with setnames() that renames dt or df columns
all_batch_patterns <- setNames(
    vector("list", length(all_batches)), 
    paste0("batch", all_batches)
)

for (batch_num in all_batches) {

    batch_name <- paste0("batch", batch_num)

    input_path <- file.path(
        "data",
        "discovery",
        "auction_patterns",
        paste0(batch_name, ".csv")
    )
    
    if (!file.exists(input_path)) {
        stop("File not found: ", input_path)
    } else {
        all_batch_patterns[[batch_name]] <- read_csv(
            input_path,
            show_col_types = FALSE
        ) |>
        select(all_of(comparison_cols))

    }

}

    # New df stores all rows of batch_patterns with id named batch_id = [batch_name]
    combined_patterns <- bind_rows(
        all_batch_patterns,
        .id = "batch_id"
    )

    pattern_behavior <- combined_patterns |>
        group_by(
            building_id,
            location_id,
            location_name,
            prefix,
            suffix
        ) |>
        summarise(
            batches_observed = n_distinct(batch_id),
            total_auctions_observed = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_batch_count = min(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_batch_count = max(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        mutate(
            evidence_level = case_when(
                batches_observed == length(all_batches) ~ "recurring",
                batches_observed >= 2 ~ "observed_multiple",
                TRUE ~ "observed_once"
            ) 
        ) |>
        arrange(
            building_id,
            prefix,
            suffix
        )

output_path <- file.path(
  "data",
  "discovery",
  "auction_patterns",
  paste0("pattern_behavior_batches", min(all_batches), "-", max(all_batches), ".csv")
)

if (file.exists(output_path)) {
    stop(
      "File already exists: ",
      output_path
    )

  } else {
    write.csv(pattern_behavior, output_path)
    message("Saved: ", output_path)
  }
```
